def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = (remaining >= 0)
    overfull = (remaining < 0)
    
    priority_scores = np.zeros_like(bins)
    
    if np.any(valid):
        # Use ratio: item size / (bin capacity + epsilon)
        # Higher ratio means item uses more of the bin -> higher priority
        ratio = item / (bins[valid] + 1e-12)
        priority_scores[valid] = ratio
    
    if np.any(overfull):
        # Exponential penalty for overfull bins
        priority_scores[overfull] = -np.exp(np.abs(remaining[overfull]))
    
    return priority_scores
